title: Carrier Rate Sheet — Enclosed Transport for Kestrel Premium Certified and Kestrel Factory Certified Vehicles
content:
**Rule.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, a Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified vehicle travels from its hub to the buyer's market in an enclosed carrier, which is priced by the mile rather than by band. The carrier price is set on the full transfer distance, according to the vehicle program and the fulfillment method of the order's handover appointment in Delivery & Pickup Appointments.

| Vehicle program | Handover appointment | Carrier price |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified | Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | the full transfer distance times $1.95 per mile (the white-glove enclosed rate), rounded half up to the cent, with no band fee |
| Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified | any other appointment | the higher of the band fee of the full transfer distance and the full transfer distance times $1.65 per mile (the enclosed rate), the per-mile product rounded half up to the cent |
| any other program | any | the band fee of the full transfer distance (open carrier) |
| any program | no handover appointment | the band fee of the full transfer distance (open carrier) |

The carrier price is the price to which the program's shipping fee discount is applied, the discounted price being rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked examples (hypothetical orders).**
- Kestrel Premium Certified, 900 miles, Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery: 900 times $1.95 is $1755.00.
- Kestrel Factory Certified, 900 miles, Kestrel Hub Pickup: 900 times $1.65 is $1485.00, higher than the $799.00 band fee: $1485.00.
- Kestrel Premium Certified, 280 miles, Kestrel Local Home Delivery: 280 times $1.65 is $462.00, lower than the $499.00 band fee: $499.00.
- Kestrel Certified Plus, 900 miles, Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery: open carrier, $799.00 band fee.
- Kestrel Factory Certified, 900 miles, no appointment yet on record: open carrier, $799.00 band fee.
